correctness.rationale: A finite-dimensional Gaussian conditioning calculation gives explicit direct covariances and zero residual cross-covariances for all distinct axes. Each scalar information term has one global location maximizer. The explicit derivative of its maximized envelope is strictly decreasing (polynomials A<0,Q>0), proving strict Jensen allocation uniqueness. Substitution verifies closed risk, dimension scale, and noiseless limit. verify.py checks 125 exact rational covariance cases, 99 root/risk cases, 4,950 supplementary comparisons and noiseless limits. Its finite experiments are not used as infinite proofs.

value.rationale: A motivated finite-budget sensing problem with d orthogonal complete hyperplane integrals is solved globally over all d positions and all precision allocations. The non-obvious conditional-independence structural identity leads to strict uniform precision optimality; the exact position solves a single equation and changes from near boundary to interior at the natural exponential dimension scale P/(d3^(d-1)). The fully specified risk and noiseless fraction 1/(8d+1) provide analytical benchmarks for integrated spatial sensing. Not an arbitrary tabulated special case or a routine variant of point sensing.
